body.name: \(\mathsf{Verify}_{\mathrm{sink}}\)
body.construction: Parse \(\Gamma_{\mathrm{sink}}\); recompute the activation fibers, trace membership, quotient classes, and rooted C-forest predicate; check normalization, positivity, rationality, and quotient sharing of \(\eta\) and \(p_0\); recompute \(A_{\eta,t,F}\) and \(b_{\eta,t,F}\) by finite structural contraction; reject if \(b_{\eta,t,F}^{\mathsf T}\in\operatorname{row}(A_{\eta,t,F})\); otherwise recompute \(h_{t,F}\), check its forest support, and check \(0<\varepsilon<\min_{j:h_{t,F,j}\ne0}\min\{p_{0j},1-p_{0j}\}/|h_{t,F,j}|\).
